rightsPolicy: No rights-cleared status until source evidence is supplied; no external or public asset URLs.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
ONE TASK.
ONE TOOL.
shots.storyboard: Low-angle analyst enters cinematic command center. Monitor wakes; the single ticket lookup becomes the focus.
shots.narrationCue: You do not need a magical autonomous bot. Start with one task, one tool, and one verification loop.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
DRAW THE
BOUNDARY
shots.storyboard: Hand approaches restricted access icon. Barrier illuminates while read-only ticket search stays accessible.
shots.narrationCue: Here is our agent: it checks ticket status. It cannot approve access, delete records, or change permissions.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
MODEL. TOOL.
VALIDATION.
shots.storyboard: Orbital camera reveals analyst, terminal, and validation monitor as distinct layers of one workflow.
shots.narrationCue: First, define the instructions. Next, expose one typed lookup function. Then validate whatever comes back.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
READ-ONLY
LOOKUP
shots.storyboard: Over-shoulder on analyst entering a ticket ID into a clean code terminal; tool response visible.
shots.narrationCue: This Python function reads a local sample database. It accepts one ticket ID and changes absolutely nothing.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
PERMISSIONS
IN CODE
shots.description: Prompts are not a security boundary.
shots.storyboard: Camera tracks a request into a guarded gateway; denied write route darkens.
shots.narrationCue: Now attach only that lookup tool to the agent. Permissions are enforced by code, not a friendly prompt.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
WATCH THE
REQUEST
shots.storyboard: Close-up: search signal passes through server, then T-104 OPEN appears on screen.
shots.narrationCue: A user asks about ticket T one-oh-four. The agent looks it up and reports the recorded status.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
TEST ALL
THREE PATHS
shots.storyboard: Three outcome monitors illuminate in sequence; failure is handled, not hidden.
shots.narrationCue: Next, we test it: a valid ID, an unknown ID, and a request to change access.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
DENY THE
WRITE
shots.storyboard: Actor reaches toward permission-change control; protective overlay blocks the action.
shots.narrationCue: The write request must fail. That is why server-side validation and human approval matter more than model confidence.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / AGENT
shots.headline:
BUILD. TEST.
REPEAT.
shots.storyboard: Wide reveal: analyst reviews execution trace, pass/fail indicators, and written test checklist.
shots.narrationCue: Your challenge: build this safe lookup, inspect the trace, and write three tests. What would you automate next?

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
THE OUTPUT
IS VAGUE
shots.storyboard: Character submits a one-line prompt; empty summary drifts into view, with no supporting source.
shots.narrationCue: When AI gives a vague answer, adding more words is not always the fix. Give it a testable task.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
BAD PROMPT,
BAD SPEC
shots.storyboard: Tight shot of vague input floating above an empty evidence desk; uncertainty becomes visible.
shots.narrationCue: Consider this prompt: summarize the incident. There is no audience, source boundary, or definition of success.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
DEFINE THE
TASK
shots.storyboard: Analyst arranges document, audience profile, and checklist into a clear work surface.
shots.narrationCue: Make the assignment precise: a SOC analyst needs observed events, uncertain details, and next checks.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
BOUND THE
SOURCE
shots.storyboard: Camera moves from source log to prompt editor; highlighted timestamps attach to each claim.
shots.narrationCue: Use only the incident log. Cite timestamps, separate observed facts from assumptions, and never invent missing evidence.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
EVIDENCE
HAS A CHAIN
shots.storyboard: Evidence slips become threads joining source lines to a supported statement.
shots.narrationCue: Now we have an evidence chain. A log line supports an observation. An observation supports a conclusion.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
STRUCTURE
THE RESULT
shots.storyboard: Organized report sections emerge on screen. Each field snaps into a validated schema.
shots.narrationCue: Request structured fields for facts, unknowns, and checks. Your application can validate that schema before displaying anything.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
FLUENCY
ISN’T PROOF
shots.storyboard: An unverified attacker label is confronted by absent evidence and stamped unsupported.
shots.narrationCue: If the answer names an attacker without supporting evidence, it fails. Fluent language is not evidence.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
CHANGE ONE
VARIABLE
shots.storyboard: Split-screen workstation compares prompt A and prompt B using identical evidence and rubric.
shots.narrationCue: Keep the document and scoring rubric fixed. Change one instruction, then compare both answers against identical tests.

shots.label: AI MASTERCLASS / PROMPTS
shots.headline:
SPECIFY. VERIFY.
ITERATE.
shots.storyboard: Cinematic hero shot: analyst sees verified citations linked across report and source.
shots.narrationCue: The real upgrade is not a secret prompt phrase. It is clear instructions plus independent verification. What works for you?

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
$25,000
ISN’T TOTAL
shots.storyboard: Buyer approaches detailed car in dealership; price tag appears, then a second larger total line emerges.
shots.narrationCue: That twenty-five-thousand-dollar car? The window sticker may not be what you actually pay. Ask for the full total.

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
GET THE
REAL QUOTE
shots.storyboard: Dealer passes a paper quote to buyer; camera tracks to itemized total and signatures area.
shots.narrationCue: Get the out-the-door price in writing: vehicle, taxes, title, registration, dealer fees, and every added product.

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
QUESTION
THE EXTRAS
shots.storyboard: Buyer points to add-on rows; optional items separate visually from taxes and title fees.
shots.narrationCue: Now examine the extras. Ask which are optional, remove anything you do not want, and request another quote.

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
PRICE AND
FINANCING
shots.storyboard: Two distinct panes: car total on left, loan APR and term on right; buyer compares.
shots.narrationCue: Separate the car deal from the loan. Compare APR, length, amount financed, total charges, and lender offers.

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
LOW MONTHLY
CAN COST MORE
shots.storyboard: Same vehicle behind two loan schedules, with longer term making lifetime cost grow.
shots.narrationCue: Beware a low monthly payment achieved by stretching the term. Lower each month can mean more interest overall.

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
INSPECT
THE CAR
shots.storyboard: Mechanic inspects a used car under soft shop lighting; buyer watches findings.
shots.narrationCue: With a used car, check history and arrange an independent inspection. A polished listing cannot reveal every problem.

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
BUDGET FOR
OWNERSHIP
shots.storyboard: Car moves through everyday environment; insurance, maintenance and energy costs enter scene.
shots.narrationCue: Add insurance, fuel or charging, maintenance, and repairs. Affording the payment is not the whole ownership budget.

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
CHECK THE
CONTRACT
shots.storyboard: Buyer and dealer examine a final contract next to written quote; terms align visually.
shots.narrationCue: Before signing, compare the final paperwork to your written quote. Check every fee, add-on, and financing term.

shots.label: EVERYDAY INTELLIGENCE / CAR
shots.headline:
SHOP THE
TOTAL COST
shots.storyboard: Buyer steps into the car lot at dusk with transparent itemized quote; cinematic closing.
shots.narrationCue: Shop the total, verify the car, and read the contract. Which surprise dealership charge deserves more attention?
